answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation (PG) is to rephrase a sentence into an alternative expression with the same semantics, which has been applied to many downstream tasks ...

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU-R to evaluate literal similarity between generated paraphrases and references. To further measure the semantic similarity, we use sentence transformer ... We also calculate the Tree Edit Distance (TED) ... Additionally, ParaScore ref and ParaScore free are used as comprehensive metrics.

answer_3.quote: preliminary evaluation using GPT-4 as a judge shows Vicuna-13B outperforms other models like LLaMA and Stanford Alpaca in more than 90% cases.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct the human evaluation on the paraphrases from the three retrieval methods (SISCP-R, QSTR, QSTR+DTS). ... we let three annotators score each paraphrase from two aspects, i.e., the overall quality (1∼5) and the diversity against the source sentence (1∼5).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated paraphrase on overall quality (1-5) and diversity with respect to the source sentence (1-5).
